map.输入摩擦片尺寸、摩擦系数、弹簧力、摩擦面数及转速，计算离合器传递扭矩与功率: Enter the friction-disc dimensions, friction coefficient, spring force, number of friction surfaces and speed to compute the clutch's transmitted torque and power
map.💡 公式：平均半径 Rm=(D+d)/4；传递扭矩 T=μ·F·Rm·z；接合面: 💡 Formula: mean radius Rm=(D+d)/4; transmitted torque T=μ·F·Rm·z; contact pressure p=F/[π(D²-d²)/4]; power P=T·n/9550
map.摩擦面数 z：单盘摩擦离合器 z=2（一对摩擦面），多盘按实际摩擦面数计: Number of friction surfaces z: for a single-disc friction clutch z=2 (one pair of friction surfaces); for multi-disc, count the actual number of friction surfaces
map.摩擦系数 μ 参考值：石棉基材料 0.25~0.35，粉末冶金 0.30~0.4: Friction coefficient μ reference values: asbestos-based material 0.25-0.35, powder metallurgy 0.30-0.40, carbon-based material 0.20-0.30
map.接合面许用压力 [p] 一般为 0.1~0.3 MPa（湿式）或 0.2~0.4: The allowable contact pressure [p] is generally 0.1-0.3 MPa (wet) or 0.2-0.4 MPa (dry)
map.计算为理想状态，实际应考虑磨损、热效应及安全系数: The calculation assumes an ideal state; in practice wear, thermal effects and a safety factor must be considered
map.螺栓预紧下法兰接合面比压 p=W/A 校核。: Verify the flange contact pressure under bolt preload, p=W/A.
map.结合 PV 值判断是否需更高压紧或更大密封面。: Combine with the PV value to judge whether higher tightening or a larger sealing surface is needed.
map.校核密封比压是否达到垫片要求。: Check whether the seal contact pressure meets the gasket requirement.
map.密封外径 D=100、内径 d=60 mm，面积 A=π(D²−d²)/4=π(: Seal outer diameter D=100, inner diameter d=60 mm, area A=π(D²−d²)/4=π(10000−3600)/4≈5026.5 mm²; bolt preload W=10 kN: p=W/A=10000/5026.5≈1.99 MPa.
map.若相对滑动速度 v=2 m/s：PV=p·v=1.99×2≈3.98 MPa·m: If the relative sliding speed v=2 m/s: PV=p·v=1.99×2≈3.98 MPa·m/s. If it exceeds the gasket's allowable PV, enlarge the sealing surface or reduce the preload.
map.比压和 PV 区别？: What is the difference between contact pressure and PV?
map.比压 p 是静态压紧应力；PV 是 p×速度，反映摩擦发热功率密度，动密封（如旋: Contact pressure p is a static clamping stress; PV is p × speed, reflecting the frictional heat-generation power density, and is critical for dynamic seals (such as rotating shafts).
map.按垫片所需最小密封比压与螺栓: Set it from the minimum seal contact pressure required by the gasket and the bolt
map.确定，过紧会压溃垫片、过松则泄漏。: specification; too tight crushes the gasket, too loose causes leakage.
